from: Commanding Officer, Marine Wing Support Squadron 000
to: President, Marine Enlisted Commissioning Education Program Selection Board
subj: LETTER OF RECOMMENDATION FOR SERGEANT J. M. OKAFOR IN SUPPORT OF THE MARINE ENLISTED COMMISSIONING EDUCATION PROGRAM

paragraphs.text: I served as Sergeant Okafor's Commanding Officer from July 2024 to July 2025 while she was the Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Nuclear Defense Chief of Marine Wing Support Squadron 000, a squadron of roughly 600 Marines and Sailors. I observed her directly, in garrison and for five months deployed.

Sergeant Okafor is recommended without reservation for selection to the Marine Enlisted Commissioning Education Program. She is the best sergeant of the approximately 45 I have commanded in two commands over four years, and the only one to whom I gave a staff noncommissioned officer's billet and never had to take it back.

She held the CBRN Chief billet, a gunnery sergeant's billet, for the full year as a sergeant. In that time she trained 550 personnel across four units on deployment, raised the squadron's CBRN readiness from 71 to 94 percent current, and accounted for $1.2 million of defense equipment through a change of command inventory with zero discrepancies. She completed 15 credits toward her degree while deployed.

In February 2025 the squadron's decontamination equipment failed a readiness inspection two days before a certification exercise. Sergeant Okafor identified the fault, sourced replacement components from the adjacent squadron, retrained the operators overnight, and the section passed the exercise on schedule. I did not direct any of it; I learned of it from the inspector.

If selected, I expect Sergeant Okafor to lead a platoon the way she led her section: by knowing the work better than the people she is leading and by setting a standard she meets first. If not selected this cycle, she will reapply, and I will write this letter again.

poc: My point of contact is Major A. B. Example at (000) 000-0000 or a.b.example@usmc.mil.
